user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents securely, extract text using OCR, identify PII, and store the metadata in a graph database for relationship querying.
normalized_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform that enables secure PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, PII detection, and graph-based metadata storage with relationship querying capabilities.
domain: Document Intelligence / Data Extraction & Privacy Compliance

requirements.description: Users must securely upload PDF documents with access control and encryption
System must extract text from PDF documents using OCR
System must detect and identify personally identifiable information (PII) within extracted text
System must store document metadata and PII findings in a queryable graph structure
Users must be able to query relationships between entities (documents, PII, metadata) via graph queries
System must enforce authentication and authorization for user access
System must provide audit logging and monitoring of document processing and access

components.name: GRAPH_QUERY_ENGINE
components.description: Enables querying relationships between documents, entities, PII, and metadata via graph traversal and pattern matching
